description.value: Wild Flour Cafe Bakery is a from-scratch bakery café in Clearwater, BC, near the gateway to Wells Gray Provincial Park. The kitchen mills its own ancient grain flours for sourdough, makes bone-broth soups in-house, and sources organic fair-trade espresso from Oso Negro Roastery in Nelson, BC. A solid resupply stop for cyclists passing through the North Thompson corridor.

address.value: 343 Clearwater Valley Rd, Clearwater BC, V0E1N2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and active, confirming the business at 343 Clearwater Valley Rd, Clearwater BC with phone 250-674-8929 — neither of which appears in OSM. The website confirms takeout service ('EAT IN OR TAKE OUT'), vegan/vegetarian/GF options consistent with OSM diet tags, and mentions catering but no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging). A notable discrepancy exists: OSM lists closing time as 16:00, but the website consistently states 2pm (14:00).
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Wild Flour bakery café' but the website consistently uses 'Wild Flour Cafe Bakery'.
Opening hours discrepancy: OSM tag shows closing time of 16:00, but website states closing time of 2pm (14:00) on multiple pages.
Phone and address absent from OSM; values sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible café confirmed via live website. Good resupply option for touring cyclists in the Clearwater/Wells Gray area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website menu lists vegan-tagged items (e.g. 'Roasted Potatoes *vegan* *g/f*') and gluten-free bread substitution available
